Our History

Passion for Adventure
From Day One

Founded in 2015, Sakura Expeditions was born from the dream of sharing the magic of the Peruvian Andes with travelers from around the world. What began as a small family business has grown to become one of the most trusted and respected operators in Cusco.

Our name, Sakura (cherry blossom in Japanese), symbolizes the fleeting and precious beauty of every moment on the mountain. Every trek is unique, every sunrise unrepeatable, and we strive to make each experience as memorable as the cherry blossom itself.

With over 10 years of experience, we've guided more than 12,000 adventurers along the Inca Trails, sharing not only routes but also stories, culture, and moments that will last a lifetime.

Mission

Offering authentic and safe experiences, connecting travelers with the magnificence of the Andes and the rich Peruvian culture.

Vision

To be leaders in sustainable tourism in Peru, recognized for our excellence, environmental responsibility, and social commitment.
